data.one_liner: Flutter wrapper around the Agora Real Time Message SDKs for Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides real-time messaging capabilities in Flutter apps by wrapping the native Agora RTM SDKs. Allows integration of low-latency real-time chat and signaling for Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need real-time messaging or signaling in your Flutter application
You are targeting Android and iOS platforms using Agora's infrastructure
avoid_when: You require web or desktop support since only Android and iOS are documented
You need a backend-agnostic or self-hosted messaging solution
strengths: Backed by the official Agora RTM native SDKs
Enables fast integration of real-time messaging features
weaknesses: Platform support is limited to Android and iOS
Requires managing Agora account and backend services
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configuring native Android and iOS projects according to the Agora RTM SDK requirements.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:agora_rtm/agora_rtm.dart';

// Usage example can be found in the official repository example directory.
